description: BillBook desktop capabilities. The auto-update check runs Rust-side (app.updater()?.check() in src/main.rs), and Rust-side calls do NOT go through the permission system - only IPC calls from the webview JS do. 'updater:default' is kept so a future in-app 'Check for updates' button works out of the box. v8.15.2 FIX: 'process:default' REMOVED - it requires the tauri-plugin-process crate, which is not a Cargo.toml dependency, so tauri-build failed with 'Permission process:default not found'. Rust-side app.restart() is core Tauri and needs no permission. If a JS relaunch button is ever added: add tauri-plugin-process = '2' to Cargo.toml, register .plugin(tauri_plugin_process::init()) in main.rs, AND restore the permission here - all three together.
